title: Kartoon Studios, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: Kartoon Studios, Inc. (ticker: TOON, NYSE American) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a debt settlement agreement with Continuation Capital, Inc. The company will issue 2,553,047 shares of common stock in exchange for settlement of $1,143,884 in past due obligations plus an additional $315,000. The agreement was court-approved on April 13, 2026 and became binding upon NYSE American approval on April 20, 2026. Shares will be issued at a rate of 1.75 shares per dollar pursuant to a Section 3(a)(10) exemption.
key_points: Kartoon Studios issued 2,553,047 shares to settle $1,143,884 in past due obligations plus $315,000 additional amount
Agreement approved by Florida Circuit Court on April 13, 2026
NYSE American approved share issuance on April 20, 2026
Shares issued at 1.75 per dollar of obligation under Section 3(a)(10) exemption
Company is listed on NYSE American with ticker symbol TOON
Filing signed by CEO Andy Heyward on April 24, 2026
